name: FUN_TRX_HEADERS
description: This tables contains the transactions that make up an intercompany transaction batch. The INITIATOR_ID, RECIPIENT_ID, and BATCH_ID together form a unique key. Each transaction is meant for one recipient however a batch can contain multiple transactions.

columns.description: Transaction identifier of the intercompany transaction.

columns.description: Transaction number of the intercompany transaction.

columns.description: Transaction amount of multitier intercompany transaction.

columns.description: Accounting date of multitier intercompany transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of multitier intercompany transaction. This is the currency in which the transaction is initiated.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion type to convert transaction currency to the currency in which funds are received by the receiver organization.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date of currency conversion from transaction currency to the currency in which funds are received by the receiver organization.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE

columns.name: MASTER_INTERCO_TXN_FLAG

columns.name: DUE_TO_FROM_CURR_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Basis for currency conversion from transaction currency defined for master document.

columns.name: DUE_TO_FROM_CURR_CODE

columns.name: DUE_TO_FROM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount in due to or due from currency. This is the amount received by the receiver organization.

columns.name: ROUTE_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: PREDECESSOR_TRX_NUMBER
